title: Self-host Supabase Auth in Docker for local development

issue.title: TASK-a7c3 Self-host Supabase Auth in Docker for local development

description: Add a self-contained Supabase (GoTrue Auth + its own Postgres) service to the local Docker Compose stack so authentication works without an external Supabase account, while keeping application source and tests unchanged.
requirements: Run GoTrue Auth with its own Postgres inside docker-compose.yml on the default network.
Keep email confirmation enabled locally (GoTrue auto-confirm; SMTP mock on :4010 stays reachable for the E2E test).
Inject SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY into the app container via docker-compose env.
Configure allowed site/redirect URLs so signup confirmation redirects to http://localhost:3000/auth.
Do not modify lib/auth.ts or existing tests; serve GoTrue routes under /auth/v1 via a proxy.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue #138 exists and defines the requested behavior.
lib/auth.ts was inspected: it reads SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from process.env at request time, so no app source change is required.
Existing E2E auth-registration test expectation (SMTP mock on :4010) was reviewed.
acceptanceCriteria: docker compose up --build brings up the app plus a local auth provider.
Signup -> login -> /api/auth/session -> public.profiles row all succeed locally.
The E2E auth-registration test expectation (SMTP mock on :4010) is preserved.
Vitest remains green with no regressions.
technicalApproach: Use supabase/gotrue:v2.196.0 serving routes at root; add docker-supabase/nginx.conf to strip /auth/v1 -> GoTrue root so lib/auth.ts:40 keeps appending /auth/v1.
Set SUPABASE_URL=http://auth-proxy:8000 in the app environment (lib/auth.ts appends /auth/v1).
Set GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM=true for reliable local signup; user signs in via /api/auth/login.
Keep docker-supabase/volumes/db/00-reserved-roles.sh for auth-db init; omit Studio and live SMTP to keep the stack minimal.
Update .env.example with placeholder guidance and a .env.local workflow for non-Docker runs.
definitionOfDone: Relevant tests/build/validator checks pass where available.
Task metadata is updated with implementation history and validation.
Changes are delivered through a task PR targeting main.

history.details: Registered from GitHub Issue #138 before implementation.

Integrated self-hosted GoTrue Auth into the root docker-compose.yml with an nginx /auth/v1 proxy, reserved-roles init script, and .env.example guidance. Verified locally (signup -> login -> session -> profiles) and vitest 119/119 green. Opened PR to main.
docker compose config validated; vitest 119/119 green per implementation notes. Full E2E auth run pending on the merged branch CI.
Refreshed docs/ai-context.md fingerprint (AI Context Freshness check); corrected stale .env.example auth URL comment; populated commits array. PR body still needs 'Closes #138' for validate-pr-task.

decisionLog.decision: Use nginx proxy to map /auth/v1 -> GoTrue root instead of changing lib/auth.ts.
decisionLog.rationale: lib/auth.ts hardcodes the /auth/v1 suffix required for real Supabase and the E2E mock provider; an nginx proxy keeps app source and tests unchanged.

decisionLog.decision: Keep email confirmation enabled via GoTrue auto-confirm locally.
decisionLog.rationale: Disabling it would break tests/e2e/auth-registration.spec.mjs, which expects the SMTP mock on :4010.
